White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a wildly entertaining and still very current production, wholly unique and well worth seeing.
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.
However, while all those questions are valid, they come across as a bit too pedantic, and the audience participation duplicates déjà-vus of postgraduate drama-devising exercises.
This is a production not to be missed: a performance that exists only in the very moment that you watch it.
This simplicity paired with the intimate venue of the Duchess Theatre creates the perfect playful environment for this bold theatrical experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this audacious theatrical experiment where actors perform unrehearsed with an unseen script, calling it engaging and mysteriously compelling, though reception ranges from enthusiastic to more measured appreciation.
